The morning supervisor on welfare walks
This section outlines what the desk expects

Companion Animal Travel Desk procedures

Purpose: This section keeps animal travel handling calm, safe, and consistent across Aurelia Skyways.

Staff must greet travelers in a warm, professional tone and check crate condition, comfort items, and airline paperwork before acceptance. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey. The ground team moves carriers carefully between services, and the safety coordinator reviews hazards and prevention so concerns are raised early. When a traveler asks for help, give clear guidance and avoid rushed handling. <<FACT F002>> Keep the pet lounge orderly, monitor handoff points, and confirm that animals are never left unattended in public areas.

Before departure, verify relief-area access and remind travelers to use the proper route for pet care. <<FACT F016>> If a crate or animal shows stress, notify the senior coordinator at once and delay transfer until the issue is resolved. Mabel, Nora Haddad, and Sara Romano may be mentioned in service notes only when needed for active support. Report any incident, delay, or welfare concern to the supervisor and the duty coordinator without delay. Contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor for any uncertain case.
